text: Main Courses: Western Economics, International Economics, Econometrics,Political Economics, Introduction to World Economy, International Trade Theory and Practice, International Finance, International Settlement, Monetary Banking, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Economics Teaching aim : The teaching aim of course is to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.
